author: KEXP
description: New Zealand quartet Yumi Zouma offer a sharp yet dreamy set of pop-inflicted indie rock in our latest in-studio session. With host DJ Cheryl Waters, the group offer a performance of "In Camera" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Yumi Zouma performs "In Camera" & more Live on KEXP
